mapper.select: SELECT * FROM coupon ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM coupon WHERE stock > 0 AND NOW() BETWEEN start_time AND end_time ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon(name, amount, min_amount, stock, start_time, end_time, create_time, status) VALUES(#{name}, #{amount}, #{minAmount}, #{stock}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{createTime}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon SET stock = stock - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND stock > 0
